description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ethical principles as represented in the MedEthicsQA dataset. The chart contains 20 slices, each representing a different ethical consideration. The slices are labeled with phrases such as “Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation,” “Comply with Laws and Regulations,” “Provide Medical Care to Patients,” “Justice,” “Non-Maleficence,” “Autonomy,” “Prevent Patient from Harm,” “Maintain Qualified Medical Care,” and “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed.” The colors of the slices vary, including shades of blue, orange, and green. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices, but the slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally decreasing in size from the top left. A legend is present, listing each ethical principle alongside its corresponding color. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
